world.description: Fresh isolated singleplayer world from the vanilla world-creation flow: flat preset, fixed seed, spectator, peaceful, no structures. Noon with the clock paused, clear weather with the weather cycle paused, open sky around the explosion. options.txt sets no video option, so every video option is the vanilla default.

sentinel.description: Open sky in the window's top-left corner, outside every frame's particles; it must not be the dark loading or menu background.
